vetSays.line: 🛡️ Norman, Elena, Ethan and Mukami met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Norman, Elena, Ethan, Mukami are hurt.
🛡️ Norman, Elena and Hind met them at the door — 3 put down. Norman, Elena, Hind are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Norman, Elena and Mukami met them at the door — 3 put down. Norman, Elena, Mukami are hurt.
🛡️ Norman, Elena, Mukami and Hind met them at the door — 4 put down. Norman, Elena, Mukami, Hind are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mukami just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Tariq just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mukami just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Norman just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mukami just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Tariq just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Norman, Elena, Mukami, Hind and Tariq met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 barely walked away. Norman, Elena, Mukami, Hind, Tariq are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Maya just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Norman just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📓 Codex: you've heard of Cold-Blooded. Someone, somewhere, can do this. Now you know its name.
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Elena — Craft 2. Three offers; they took Cold-Blooded. Earned, chosen. (cold_blooded: villager level-up)
📓 Codex: Elena chose Cold-Blooded (cold_blooded) at Craft 2.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Maya just put down The Suburb... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Maya just put down The Eater... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Maya just put down The Ugly Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📓 Codex: A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek — jotted down what they said. Filed.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Vasyl just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
🛡️ Vasyl and Tashi met them at the door — 2 put down. Vasyl, Tashi are hurt.
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Elena Levy, 25 — a dry cleaner. Her hands know different work now: Iron Stomach, Green Whisper, Berserker Rage, Cold-Blooded, Scream Cheese.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
